message.content: {"basis": "The dashboard visually encodes incidence levels via color: pale yellow for high (100) and dark red for low (0). Missouri (MO) is shaded pale yellow, matching the 100 mark, while Mississippi (MS) and Delaware (DE) are dark red, matching the 0 mark. Among the three listed options, Missouri is the only state with the highest incidence level shown. The task requires selecting the highest-incidence state from the listed options, and Missouri is the only one meeting that criterion.", "option_label": "Open Missouri (MO) incidence detail for priority follow-up"}
